csv_scope_of_work: The Agency is seeking proposals from qualified and licensed entities to provide architectural and engineering services, potentially for all programs the Agency administers. The Agency intends to award a contract to a firm(s) to provide architectural and engineering services (A/E) for various projects the Agency may need throughout the year. Services will include, but are not limited to, typical A/E services pertaining to, on an as-needed basis at the Agency's discretion, both new construction and rehabilitation of buildings, and land that the Agency owns. Services may include, but are not limited to, typical A/E services pertaining to: 2.2.1 Site Planning; 2.2.2 Structural, mechanical, electrical and civil engineering 2.2.3 Landscaping; 2.2.4 Cost estimating; and 2.2.5 Construction contract administration.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
